entries.title: Weekend freeway closures/restrictions in Phoenix area
entries.notes: PHOENIX – Closures or lane restrictions for improvement projects are scheduled along several freeways in the Phoenix area this weekend (Friday, Oct. 9-Monday, Oct. 12): EB L-101 (Agua Fria Freeway) closed between 75th and 51st avenues. EB L-202 (Santan Freeway) closed between Arizona Avenue and Gilbert Road. NB SR 51 closed between Indian School Road and Glendale Avenue. SR 347 narrowed to one lane in both directions between the City of Maricopa and Casa Blanca Road. Restriction schedules are subject to change due to inclement weather or other factors.

interpretation: Public AZ511 alert listings with publisher update times. A dated regional notice is not a geocoded event, observed closure, stadium route impact, or live police alert.
